name: Muhallebi
description: A silky chilled milk pudding set with rice flour and perfumed with rose water, garnished with crushed pistachios.
ingredients: a handful of fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with unsalted butter.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pide bread and ground cumin until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the lemon wedges with the beef stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 15 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
